lines.text: WELCOME, happy morning Age to age shall say; Hell to-day is Vanquished Heaven is won to-day Lo, the Dead is living God for ever more Him their true Creator All His works adore!
Earth with joy confesses Clothing her for spring All good gifts return‘d with Her returning King: Bloom in every meadow, Leaves on every bough, Speak His sorrow ended Hail His triumph now.

Months in due succession Days of lengthening lights, Hours and passing moments Praise thee in their flight Brightness of the morning Sky and fields, and sea Vanquisher of darkness Bring their praise to Thee.
Loose the hearts long prison'd Bound with Satan‘s chain All that now is fallen raise to life again Show Thy face in Brightness Bid the nations see; Bring again our daylight; Day returns with thee.
